description: Lists the next vehicles of the TTC at a stop: route number, kind, headsign, minutes from as_of, and the expected instant. live is true when the TTC tracks the vehicle; else the time comes from the timetable. With a route, lists the next vehicles of that route only.

language.description: The language of the names: ka or en. The default is en.

limit.description: The maximum count of arrivals, 1 to 30. The default is 10.

route.description: Only this route: its number (385) or its id. Empty gives the next vehicle of each route.

stop.description: The stop id (1:1000) or the stop code (1000).

name: transit_list_arrivals

expected.description: The expected instant of the arrival, RFC 3339.

headsign.description: The destination that the vehicle shows.

live.description: True when the TTC tracks the vehicle. False when the time comes from the timetable.

minutes.description: The minutes from as_of to the arrival.

as_of.description: The instant at which the server read the arrivals, RFC 3339. minutes count from it.

source.description: The source of the data: TTC.

code.description: The number on the sign of a bus stop. Absent for a station of metro or cable car.

id.description: The stop id, for example 1:1000. Every transit tool that takes a stop accepts it.

kind.description: bus, metro, or cable_car. A minibus stops at a bus stop.

lat.description: The latitude of the stop, in degrees.

lon.description: The longitude of the stop, in degrees.

title: Next arrivals at a stop in Tbilisi
